assets.name: 路面
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Regenerate this road texture with HORIZONTAL RECTANGULAR BRICKS, keeping this exact palette and cute simple top-down cartoon style. The reference is too square. Keep EXACTLY FOUR horizontal rows, but use EXACTLY TWO complete brick widths across each row, so each full brick is TWICE AS WIDE AS IT IS TALL. Square canvas 1024x1024. Approximately 8 full 2:1 rectangular brick areas in total. NOT square blocks, NOT 4 columns, NOT 8 rows. Mandatory half-brick stagger: rows 1 and 3 have joints at x=0,512,1024; rows 2 and 4 have joints at x=256,768 with matching cropped HALF BRICKS on left and right. Horizontal joints at y=0,256,512,768,1024.
This is a seamless repeating MATERIAL texture. Opposite edges must join exactly when identical copies are placed in a grid without flips or rotation. Top and bottom image edges have exactly matching narrow HALF-width grout strips, same uniform color, so the total joint equals the internal grout width. Left/right cut-off half-bricks continue with exactly the same color, contour, shine and shading, no discontinuity. The TWO half-bricks on the left and right of each offset row must be the SAME color. Do not round or outline the image boundary; round the small internal corners of individual bricks only.
Thin soft low-contrast grout, very restrained broad internal highlights, quiet smooth cartoon faces. NO chunky bevel, NO directional gradient across the image, NO peripheral shadow, NO blank margin, NO border, NO framing, NO text, NO perspective, NO texture grain, NO tiny clutter. Only the paving surface, fill the entire opaque square. Prioritize correct horizontal rectangular running-bond layout and seamless opposite edges. Keep the original map's palette. Alternate pastel powder-blue and pale lilac rectangular bricks, similar brightness. Thin pearl-gray grout. Odd-row edge halves must both be BLUE or both be LILAC, never mismatched, to ensure seamless color. Only very faint rain sheen. Production asset neon_alley/road.
Final seam refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is an almost finished repeating road texture. Make ONE SMALL SEAM REPAIR, preserve its FOUR horizontal rows, TWO brick widths per row, horizontal 2:1 rectangular brick shapes, HALF-BRICK STAGGER, pastel blue/lilac palette and all existing brick positions. Do NOT change the layout, counts, rectangular proportions, or palette.
The topmost image edge currently has a dark purple/gray line, while the bottommost edge is cream. REPAIR: make both the top and bottom outer edge strips exactly the SAME uniform pale pearl-cream grout color, matching the current bottom edge. Half the normal internal joint width on the top, half on the bottom. Remove any dark outline touching the top or bottom image boundary. Combined copies must form ONE ordinary thin joint, not a double-thick band. Keep no dark frame around the overall square. The left/right edges likewise need matching continuation: on rows 2 and 4 the cut-off lavender half-bricks must join as one lavender rectangle with continuous uniform color; remove the faint shine fragment touching the LEFT edge so it matches the shading that continues from the RIGHT half-brick. Retain restrained shine well inside complete bricks. Opaque 1024x1024 square PNG. Seamless ordinary repeat on all four sides with no mirroring. No new objects, no text, no grain. Production asset neon_alley/road.
